personality_one_liner: A structured, authoritative, and clean project management tool that frames complex renovation budgets with clarity and trust.

spacing.rule: Generous native spacing. Use lg or xl for screen padding. Use md for component gaps.

do's: Use on floating sticky header during scroll
Use on floating action buttons (FABs) with a brandTertiary tint
Use on featured project summary cards sitting on background imagery
dont's: Do not use on regular list items or form inputs
Do not use on generic body content

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A dashboard overview showing total budget, spend, active renovation progress, and quick action buttons.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for budget summary card.
states.empty: No active projects. Display empty state with blueprint background and CTA to start first project.
states.error: Failed to load project details with a retry button.

screens.layout: Dashboard-first layout. Top: Large hero card with background imagery (Victorian house) overlaid with a dark gradient scrim and white text showing current project ('Nottingham Victorian Refurb') and big metrics (Total Budget vs Spent) with a progress bar. Below: 2-column grid or list of recent expenses. Bottom: Sticky primary CTA for 'Add Expense'.

screens.name: Budget
screens.purpose: Detailed list of budget line items and AI cost estimates.

states.empty: No line items logged. Display subtle illustration and 'Add Item' primary CTA.

screens.layout: Filter chips at the top (Hard, Soft, Contingency). A vertically scrolling list of line items (title, category, cost). A sticky primary CTA ('Add Item') at the bottom. The AI Cost Estimate feature is accessed via a prominent secondary banner/card at the top of the list.

screens.name: Team
screens.purpose: Directory of tradespeople, subcontractors, and stakeholders.

states.empty: No team members added. Show yellow hard hat image and 'Add Trade' button.

screens.layout: Vertical list view with avatar/initials on the left, name and trade on the right. Each row contains quick-action icon buttons (WhatsApp, Call). Pro-locked stakeholders are visually distinct with a 'Pro' badge.

screens.name: Media
screens.purpose: Gallery for receipts and before/after photos.

states.empty: No media uploaded. Display empty state asking to upload first receipt.

screens.layout: A 2-column or 3-column grid of thumbnails for photos and receipts. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right to launch camera/gallery upload.

screens.name: Profile & Plan
screens.purpose: User settings, BRRR calculator access, and Pro tier upgrade.
screens.layout: Accessed via header icon. Contains user details, a highly visible 'Upgrade to Pro' card detailing features (BRRR calculator, Stakeholders), and settings toggles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality: highly structured, legible, with generous padding, separating data effectively.

Brand colors are set: Teal (#0f766e) is the main identity, Orange (#f97316) is strictly for the Primary CTAs (brandPrimary) to drive action. Green 50 (#f0fdf4) is the brandTertiary used for subtle tinted backgrounds.
All interactive primary buttons (like 'Add Expense') must be sticky above the tab bar within a safe area.

For the Home screen 'Nottingham Victorian Refurb' hero card, USE the `hero_victorian` image as a background WITH a mandatory top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) so that white text overlay is readable.
Use Lucide icons across the app per the prompt request, ensuring consistent weight (e.g., all outlined) per screen.
For Team/Trades list items, implement direct integrations for WhatsApp and calls as quick action icon buttons on each row.
For Pro features (BRRR calculator, Stakeholders), add lock icons or 'Pro' badges if the user is on the basic tier, steering them to the Profile/Plan upgrade screen.
Integrate haptic feedback on tab changes, CTA presses, and list item interactions. Serialize haptics into your components.
